Global constant-delay trajectory is the signed triangle wave bounded by one, verifying all assumptions of the published subcritical theorem. Monotonicity of phi ensures a unique local implicit-delay root tau*=1+(eta*M)/(1+eta*M)*t and identical local implicit solution. At criticality the nested delays alternate 1 and 1+t for all finite orders, yielding h_odd=a-t and h_even=a. Exact rational checker passed 140 triples and 25 orders. No finite test is treated as the general proof.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 source explicitly leaves the noncontracting regime unexplored. This result identifies an exact natural history-regularity boundary in the very model of the source, with sharp immediate trajectory failure on the boundary, and separates unique implicit solvability from convergence of nested approximations. The transition is realized for arbitrarily weak response strength eta by increasing the history slope, a meaningful robustness constraint. The result has specified family and local scope, not a claimed general theorem.
